headline: Colombia's 42-Hour Workweek Shapes 2027 Minimum Wage Debate
summary: Colombia's maximum workweek reduction to 42 hours has increased hourly labor costs for employers, becoming a central factor in the 2027 minimum wage negotiations.
why: Changes in statutory working hours and minimum wages directly impact corporate operating margins and labor cost inflation across the country.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Shorter statutory workweeks increase hourly labor costs, influencing nationwide minimum wage policy and business overheads.
